title: Guarded protected use
rationale: Use is disabled in every dirty state.

title: Repair on handler return
rationale: Handler returns only after its repair, and no nested delivery is declared.

title: Drain before neutralization
rationale: Neutralization has no outgoing edge from a pending-effect state.

title: Logical cancellation of stale effects
rationale: A canceled pending update is explicitly unable to dirty the state. This is an assumption, not a counter-width proof.

title: Dirty interior use with clean return
rationale: Checking only the handler return omits a bad interior prefix.

title: Clean return without interior use
rationale: Same timed state path and return relation as C01; interior event is not a protected use.

title: Pending effect survives neutralization
rationale: Cleaning visible state does not cancel a declared pending update.

title: Explicit pending cancellation
rationale: The pending update is modeled as canceled and preserves the clean predicate.

title: Strict sub-tick delivery window
rationale: Integer-only time exploration misses the open interval (0,1).

title: Delivery after the use window
rationale: A dirty state is reachable, but every dirty use is timing-infeasible.

title: Two-delivery threshold
rationale: One-delivery safety does not extend to two deliveries.

title: Nested delivery after outer repair
rationale: A repair before a nested delivery does not justify the outer return.
